more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Dimethyl dicarbonate is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, other, wine and other products defined in annex vii part ii of regulation (eu) no 1308/2013, cider and perry. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no indication of concern at reported beverage-use levels in 2015. The additive rapidly reacts or breaks down before consumption.
The reaction products were assessed, but data were insufficient for an ADI.
